text:
marie: quick summary - QEMs (post-PTQ) onboard canary is showing a new class of malformed JSON when funcalls include code strings with embedded quotes. only reproducible on streaming+kv_trim and only for one prompt template.

derek: numbers?

marie: from 3k sample: fp16/int8 parse_fail ~0.12%, qat-int4 ~0.9%, qem-ptq-int4 ~2.6%. failures cluster on prompts where args.patch includes multiline code with """ triple quotes.

yang: paste a raw reassembled stream sample?

marie: here (chunks reassembled in arrival order):

```
Assistant: generating...
{
  "action": "apply_patch",
  "args": {
    "patch": "def handler():
      print(\"start\")
      return \"ok\"
"
  }
}
METADATA:run=42

```

marie: notice the backslash-escaped quotes inside the code string then a newline; in several cases the int4 QEM emits an extra raw quote token across chunk boundary producing:

```
...
\"return \"ok\"\n\"\n  }\n}\n```

marie: which leaves an extra '"' that breaks strict parse. fp16/int8 tend to include explicit escaped chars as single token; quantized tokenization sometimes emits an unescaped quote token.

oleg: CI note: ci-bot detected PR 2048 touching stream-reassembler recently (changed sanitization order). ci-bot: PR 2048 flagged as possibly interacting.

ci-bot: grep shows 87 malformed cases in canary logs, peak at 02:10 UTC.

frank: quick mitigations: 1) pre-parse sanitizer that collapses repeated unpaired quote tokens at top-level if they appear adjacent to closing object and simple heuristic says safe (low risk), 2) move METADATA emission to structured header so it never races in-band, 3) add token-offset debug trace for repro.

yang: sanitizer risk: could mask real bad outputs. we should only apply it when repaired_count is low and record repaired=true in telemetry. also run semantic-equality check vs gold.

derek: can we reproduce deterministically with a seed? if yes we should run token-level diff between fp16/int8/ptq to see where tokenization diverges.

marie: repro runs with seed=42, batch=4, kv_trim=true reproduce ~70% locally. attaching small token dump helped: shows an extra standalone '"' token emitted at boundary in qem-ptq.

oleg: plan: A) enable sanitizer in canary for qem-ptq-int4 streaming only tonight (01:00 UTC) with repaired telemetry, B) enable token-offset traces and chunk seq numbers, C) infra to move METADATA header out-of-band (LOG-980), D) schedule model team investigate quant vocab mapping (MODEL-557).

frank: agree. also add onboarding eval: run the code-fence heavy template set across all quant candidates and require parse_fail<0.5% or repaired<=0.5% else fail onboarding. ticket EVAL-1620.

ci-bot: scheduled canary roll at 01:00 UTC and will post deploy result.

marie: i'll push the sanitizer to canary and post a 12h snapshot. will attach token dumps for the model team. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
